title: 旅客提著箱子走過航站

data.prompt: Close-up of a desk in a 1970s office, a generic clerk in a cardigan turning the page of a thick bound document with blank pages and simple line drawings of a box on rollers, the paper is the focal object, mild lamp light from the left, quiet and curious mood

lines.text: 那段長路，就在大型航站裡。
Sadow 寫道，旅行大幅增加，搬行李的方式也跟著變了。

data.prompt: Medium shot of an old railway station platform in the mid-twentieth century, one generic porter in a plain cap lifting a heavy unmarked leather trunk onto a hand cart, the trunk is the focal object, soft grey sky through a glass roof, calm nostalgic mood

lines.text: 以前，行李多由搬運工替人處理。
到了大型航站，常常變成乘客自己提。

lines.text: Sadow 的申請書還點名火車站和巴士站：沒人幫忙時，旅客得自己搬箱子走完長路。

data.prompt: Medium product shot of one plain closed mid-century leather suitcase resting on a neutral workbench. Its ordinary rectangular shape and original top carrying handle are easy to see; the underside is hidden for the moment. Gentle side lamp light, no hands, labels, marks or text.

lines.text: 他的申請書要求箱子仍保留普通的形狀、大小和樣式，卻能讓旅客拖著走。

The unopened case and unresolved latch are the focus, soft workshop light, no visible wheels, drawings, lettering or logos.

lines.text: 剛才說的箱底四輪，在說明書裡還分屬箱蓋與箱身；究竟各裝在哪裡？

data.prompt: Low three-quarter view of a generic horizontal suitcase as a patent design example, not an identified manufactured artifact. The case is closed with its seam clear: two small roller assemblies under the lid half and two under the body half. Soft side light, no text, labels or logos.

lines.text: 在 Sadow 專利的示例裡，兩組輪子裝在箱蓋底，另兩組在箱身底。

lines.text: 剛才說箱子能跟著人走，專利把做法寫得更清楚：拖帶扣在箱端小環，讓旅客在平地上拖行。

claims.claim: 那段長路，就在大型航站裡；Sadow 寫道，旅行大幅增加，搬行李的方式也跟著變了
claims.note: 3d52 對應 fact 0「大型航站讓乘客常得自己提行李、走很遠的路」。gtab 對應 fact 0「說明書寫到旅行大幅成長，以前行李由搬運工處理」。兩句沒有提到銷量因果，也沒有重量壓手臂的重述。未改字

claims.claim: 以前，行李多由搬運工替人處理；到了大型航站，常常變成乘客自己提
claims.note: ij3c、bgdh 與 fact 0「以前行李由搬運工處理，如今的大型航站讓乘客常得自己提行李」一致。source 0 的 supports 也列出這段說明書敘述。未改

claims.claim: 說明書並列航空、鐵路、巴士航站中的自行搬運需求
claims.note: Round11 NOT FOUND provenance retained: original source-absence rationale is contradicted by Sadow US3653474A BACKGROUND. engine-04 is retired; round12 r12e01 independently rewords the terminal point and remains PENDING.

claims.claim: 發明人形容行李搬運可能是搭機旅客最大的難題
claims.note: Round11 NOT FOUND provenance retained: original source-absence rationale is contradicted by Sadow US3653474A BACKGROUND. engine-05 is retired; the superlative is not restored to round12 narration.

claims.claim: 箱子橫放著拖行，人在前面，它在後面佔著一段地面。可是這種拖法，還有地方可以再改
claims.note:
各來源的依據如下：
- source 5（USA TODAY）寫 Rollaboard 把箱子「from horizontal to vertical」，並說 Sadow 的設計「lacked the nimbleness」。
- source 4（Wikipedia）寫「tow it behind him」與「flat like Sadow's model」。
- source 0 專利寫「flexible transport strap」拉行。
「還有地方可以再改」只是過場，翻倒、撞腳踝留給下一章，並歸給 Travelpro。claim 欄的文字已改成和現稿一致

claims.claim: 箱子已經不必一路提著了，天天跑機場的人，為什麼還想換一種拉法？
claims.note: source 1（Travelpro）寫 Sadow 的設計讓旅客「no longer have to carry a heavy suitcase by the handle」，也寫機組員厭倦在機場拖著笨重的登機箱。本句是問句，沒有新的數字或名稱。claim 欄的文字已改成和現稿一致
